rundown: Broncos beat Zips 42-14 at InfoCision Stadium in Akron, OH. Broncos led 21-7 at the half and never looked back. The 1st quarter decided it: Broncos won it 7-0. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 86%).
Scoring: Broncos 4 touchdowns and 0 field goals; Zips 2 touchdowns and 0 field goals. The last score: M. Reynolds pass to N. Levicki for 10 yds, for a TD (D. Kelly KICK) (4th quarter, 6:53).

Leading the way — Broncos: Broc Lowry 15/15, 149 yds, 1 TD; Jalen Buckley 23 car, 121 yds, 2 TD; Baylin Brooks 8 rec, 78 yds. Zips: Cibastian Broughton 12/18, 173 yds, 2 TD; Jordan Gant 9 car, 61 yds; Marcel Williams 5 rec, 85 yds, 2 TD.
Where Broncos won it: they outgained them 566 yards to 233 and held the ball 42:46 to 17:14.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Broncos closed as 15.5-point favorites and covered by 12.5; the total closed at 50.5 and they combined for 56, over by 5.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 10, 6:58 PM ET. It had Broncos 79% and Zips 21%, projecting Broncos 32.7 – Zips 20.7 (53.4 total, Broncos by 12).

Final: Broncos 42 – Zips 14. Right winner: it had Broncos at 79%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Broncos came in with a 7% below average attack and a 4% stingier than average defense (6-3, 26.2 scored and 19.2 allowed a game over 9 games), worth about 167 and 167 games of evidence. Projected to score 32.7, they scored 42 (+9.3 points, 28% over); projected to allow 20.7, they allowed 14 (−6.7 points, 32% under).

Zips came in with a 20% below average attack and a 32% leakier than average defense (1-8, 19.1 scored and 32.2 allowed a game over 9 games), worth about 17 and 167 games of evidence. Projected to score 20.7, they scored 14 (−6.7 points, 32% under); projected to allow 32.7, they allowed 42 (+9.3 points, 28% over).

The bigger miss was Broncos' scoring (+9.3 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 56 against 53.4 projected (+2.6), about the 57th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±15.5).

Margin: Broncos by 28 against Broncos by 12 projected, about the 15th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±15.3).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Zips ×1.00, Broncos ×1.02. It favored Broncos, who did beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
AKR ML (+525) at +525: the algo gave it 17% vs 15% fair (+1.2 pts), THE PICK — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 15%). WMU ML (-750) at -750: the algo gave it 83% vs 85% fair (-1.2 pts) — won (+0.1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 85%). AKR +15.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 52% vs 50% fair (+1.6 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. WMU -15.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 48% vs 50% fair (-1.6 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. OVER 50.5 (-118) at -118: the algo gave it 52% vs 52% fair (+0.4 pts) — won (+0.8u); same number as the close. UNDER 50.5 (-102) at -102: the algo gave it 48% vs 48% fair (-0.4 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 62% of bets on Broncos, 49% of the money — Broncos covered; total: 82% of bets on the over, 83% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 97% of bets on Broncos, 73% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Broncos, who won and covered.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.017 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -17.5 points. It counts toward CFB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 62 graded CFB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.971 and gives home teams -1.5 points. Team corrections start after 3 graded games for a team.

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 16 points), the pick lost (-1u).
